groups.directions:
Topic: Match the Column
Subtopic: Sentence Matching

questions.text:
Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. The company decided to launch its new product
B. Although he was feeling extremely exhausted
C. The government has introduced new subsidies

Column II:
D. he managed to complete the marathon in record time.
E. aimed at promoting renewable energy across the state.
F. ahead of the upcoming holiday season.
questions.explanation: A matches with F (launching product ahead of holiday season).

questions.text:
Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. To prevent the spread of the contagious virus
B. The sudden drop in global oil prices
C. Before signing the final contract

Column II:
D. has significantly impacted the economies of exporting nations.
E. the authorities imposed a strict nationwide lockdown.
F. you should carefully read all the terms and conditions.
questions.explanation: A matches with E (prevent virus -> impose lockdown).

questions.text:
Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. The archeological team discovered ancient ruins
B. In an effort to reduce their carbon footprint
C. Because the weather was unpredictable

Column II:
D. many corporations are adopting hybrid work models.
E. they decided to carry umbrellas just in case.
F. dating back to the early Roman empire.
questions.explanation: A matches with F (ancient ruins dating back to Roman empire).

questions.text:
Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. Unless you apologize for your rude behavior
B. The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence
C. Not only did she secure the highest grade

Column II:
D. presents both unprecedented opportunities and ethical challenges.
E. but she also received a full scholarship to the university.
F. I will not allow you to participate in the project.
questions.explanation: A matches with F (Unless you apologize -> I will not allow you).

questions.text:
Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. The negotiations were incredibly tense
B. Due to the lack of sufficient funding
C. He invested heavily in real estate

Column II:
D. hoping to secure a stable passive income for his retirement.
E. the ambitious infrastructure project had to be shelved indefinitely.
F. as both nations refused to compromise on border security.
questions.explanation: A matches with F (tense negotiations -> refused to compromise).

questions.text:

questions.text:

questions.text:

Topic: Match the Column
Subtopic: Sentence Matching

questions.text:
Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. Scarcely had the central bank announced the stimulus package
B. The phenomenon of quantum entanglement
C. Providing equitable access to high-speed internet

Column II:
D. is now considered a fundamental human right by several international bodies.
E. when the major stock indices rallied to record highs.
F. continues to baffle physicists with its counter-intuitive implications.

Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. The treaty was intentionally drafted with ambiguous language
B. Had the intelligence agencies coordinated their efforts
C. The proliferation of deeply convincing synthetic media

Column II:
D. poses a severe threat to the integrity of democratic elections.
E. they could have easily thwarted the sophisticated cyber-attack.
F. allowing participating nations to interpret it to their domestic advantage.

questions.text:
Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. The sheer magnitude of the logistical challenge
B. Lest the proprietary algorithms fall into the hands of competitors
C. Driven by an insatiable curiosity about the cosmos

Column II:
D. the brilliant astrophysicist dedicated her life to studying dark matter.
E. the corporation isolated its core research servers from the main network.
F. required the mobilization of resources across three different continents.
questions.explanation: A matches with F (magnitude of challenge -> required mobilization).

questions.text:
Match the halves in Column I with those in Column II to form meaningful sentences.
Column I:
A. Not only did the draconian policies stifle grassroots innovation
B. The symbiotic relationship between the fungi and the tree roots
C. An overriding reliance on subjective human intuition

Column II:
D. often leads to catastrophic errors in complex statistical forecasting.
E. facilitates the exchange of vital nutrients essential for survival.
F. but they also triggered a massive brain drain to neighboring countries.
questions.explanation: A matches with F (Not only... but they also...).
